what: First run of the concern model, the evidence inventory and the fill step on real repositories. All repositories are described by shape only. Public repositories are named because they are public.

generality_matrix.method: docs_evidence.py and docs_structure.py run read-only on shallow clones (--depth 100..300); pass = exits 0, ecosystem recognised where a detector exists, kinds a maintainer would name, zero secret-shaped strings in the JSON, under 5 s

repos.covered: 3/11 (develop by development.md, deploy by deployment.md, contribute by CONTRIBUTING.md - all by heading match)
3/10 (develop, data, testing all from README sections)

repos.note: routes fell from 148 to 6 once test files stopped counting as evidence
Kubernetes, Helm and Terraform detectors exercised; Service and Ingress are not counted as deployable units
cli kind from a binary crate without a known parser dependency; HTML <a name> anchors accepted as link targets
shared reference-link definitions are the generator's, not checked
Elixir detector added during the trial: mix.exs, Phoenix router, Ecto migrations
negative control: 0 routes after comment lines, test files and library-crate code stopped counting; was 131

local_by_shape.shape: a shaped pnpm monorepo with 110 docs, a central index and a Node verifier of its own
local_by_shape.note: the two uncovered concerns, testing and operate, are real gaps; the twelve existing rules still report 0

local_by_shape.shape: a Next.js app with 82 loose docs, five dated record folders and no index
a polyglot repo (Move contracts, Node indexer, React frontend) with three docs at the repo root
local_by_shape.note: README covers architecture and the API through its sections

local_by_shape.shape: a notes-only repo of seven Markdown files
a three-package repo (React app at the root, an Express server with Prisma, a Python agent service with FastAPI and compose), docs as per-package READMEs, no docs folder
local_by_shape.covered: 6/10 after the fix in #18 (3/10 before: the per-package READMEs were invisible and two code folders were proposed as docs roots)
local_by_shape.note: the four gaps (plan, design, testing, operate) are real; the root README's env-var notes count as covering deploy and data by heading, which is generous

fill_trial.shape: the polyglot repo above, cloned to a throwaway copy
steps: plan: 5 concerns uncovered (purpose, plan, data, design, testing); README is the index; DEPLOYMENT.md and a setup guide hand-written
init: copied five templates plus the first phase file, wrote docs-structure.json with roots ['*.md'], appended a Documents list to the README (10 lines added, 0 removed)
fill: drafted DATA_MODEL.md (four sections from schema.prisma, package scripts and three dated commits) and TESTING.md (four sections; two open questions; one negative claim with its search scope)
gate: every bracket resolved to a file, a model name in that file or a commit; one banned word caught in a draft ('clean install') and reworded; 0 line-number citations; 0 env values
check: Failures 0, Concerns 9 covered / 0 missing, Sections 13 skeleton / 8 draft / 22 reviewed; hand-written DEPLOYMENT.md untouched, its absent template sections reported as advice
found_along_the_way: a test script that runs jest with no jest dependency and no test files - the draft states it with evidence and marks the conclusion inferred
the draft's Inventory line says 0 committed migrations although the schema exists; prisma migrate dev is run from a script, which the draft cites
bugs_fixed: a manifest whose index is the root README did not put the checker into root-docs mode, so new root docs were treated as unreachable
the front door was asked to link itself when it is the index
the agent-side gate pass misread mid-paragraph brackets and table header rows (the scripts have no gate; the agent runs it)

not_yet: a real split with the preservation gate
docs-sync-audit over a filled repo as the honesty check on drafts
a Railway check on the second trial repo (drafts say so in their header)

fill_trial_2.shape: the three-package repo above, cloned to a throwaway copy
steps: plan: 4 concerns uncovered; init proposed docs/ at the root with INDEX, manifest, TASKLIST + phase file, DESIGN_GUIDELINES, TESTING, RUNBOOK and one README line
fill: drafted TESTING (4 sections), RUNBOOK (4 sections) and DESIGN_GUIDELINES (5 sections, two of them a single open question) from 30 files; plan left as a skeleton

gate: two citations pointed at agent instruction files that are gitignored in that repo and so absent from the clone - re-cited to tsconfig files; one 'because' and one 'must' reworded; then OK on all three
check: Failures 0 on R12, Concerns 10 covered / 0 missing, Sections 13 draft / 20 reviewed; R6 (opt-in) found 3 stale backticked paths in a hand-written README
found_along_the_way: the generated manifest's roots omitted the per-package READMEs discovery had just used, so the first check after apply lost three covered concerns - fixed: init writes them into roots
the API's health probe leaves HEALTH_TOKEN-gated internals public while the token is unset; the repo's own ops README says so and the draft cites it
no CI: the only automated check is a pre-commit hook; 122 Express routes and two workers have no tests
